parameters.formDescription: Enter your search criteria to find new business leads.

values.placeholder: e.g. real estate agency, plumber, dentist

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO leads (
  external_id,
  business_name,
  phone,
  address,
  city,
  state,
  country,
  website_url,
  category,
  source,
  status,
  rating,
  review_count,
  search_query,
  created_at,
  updated_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.external_id }}',
  '{{ $json.business_name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.phone }}',
  '{{ $json.address.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.city }}',
  '{{ $json.state }}',
  '{{ $json.country }}',
  '{{ $json.website_url }}',
  '{{ $json.category }}',
  '{{ $json.source }}',
  '{{ $json.status }}',
  {{ $json.rating ?? 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.review_count ?? 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $json.search_query.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  NOW(),
  NOW()
) ON CONFLICT (external_id) DO NOTHING;
